title: Japanese-Style Chicken Satay
description: A creative twist on the classic Southeast Asian dish, featuring Japanese flavors and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the prepared baking sheet and roast for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the peanuts in a small dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Garnish with green onions and toasted peanuts. Serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
